selectors.reason: The Hall must expose shared authority and mutation boundaries before action.
A bound entry needs its declared Member and Desk disclosure without claiming a current human.

A Place reveals only its local children and applicable methods.
A Meeting exposes collaboration state, Occupants, Work relations and next boundary.
A Work position exposes its sources, destination, verification and Outcome contract.
A Site position exposes sovereign product sources without granting delivery.
Provider memory and global Skills are not Workplace truth or authority.
